title: Network analysis and experimental pharmacology study explore the protective effects of Isoliquiritigenin on 5-fluorouracil-Induced intestinal mucositis.
authors: Liao, Yi-Fan; Luo, Feng-Lin; Tang, Shan-Shan; Huang, Jing-Wei; Yang, Ying; Wang, Shuang; Jiang, Tang-Yu; Man, Qiong; Liu, Sha; Wu, Yi-Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文研究甘草成分ISL对5-FU诱导肠黏膜炎的保护作用，采用网络药理学和分子对接预测靶点，但核心是药物-蛋白作用及炎症通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，也无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) is one of the most widely used chemotherapy drugs for malignant tumors. However, intestinal mucositis caused by 5-FU is a severe dose-limiting toxic effect and even leads to treatment interruption. Isoliquiritigenin (ISL) is one of the main active compounds of licorice, which is a traditional Chinese herbal medicine commonly used in inflammation and gastrointestinal diseases. It is speculated that ISL have protective effects on intestinal mucositis. However, no such studies have been reported. Therefore, to investigate the impact of ISL on 5-Fu-induced intestinal mucositis, a strategy based on network prediction and pharmacological experimental validation was proposed in this study. Firstly, the targets and mechanism of ISL in alleviating 5-Fu-induced gastrointestinal toxicity were predicted by network analysis. And the results were further confirmed by molecular docking. Then, a mouse model of intestinal mucositis was established by intraperitoneal injection of 5-FU (384 mumol/kg) to verify the prediction of network analysis. The network analysis results suggested that PTGS2 (Prostaglandin G/H synthase 2) and NOS2 (Nitric oxide synthase, inducible) might be the critical targets of ISL for reducing the intestinal toxicity of 5-FU. In addition, KEGG and GO enrichment analysis revealed that the HIF-1, TNF, MAPK, IL-17, PI3K-Akt, Ras, NF-kappa B signaling pathway, and biological processes of the inflammatory response, apoptosis regulation, NO production and NF-kappa B transcription factor activity might be involved in the mechanism of ISL against intestinal mucositis. Subsequent animal experiments showed that ISL could reduce the weight loss, leukopenia and mucosal damage caused by 5-FU. Compared with the intestinal mucositis model, the protein expressions of PTGS2, NOS2, TNFalpha (Tumor necrosis factor-alpha) and NF-kappaB p65 (nuclear factor kappa-B P65) were decreased after ISL treatment. In conclusion, this study is the fist time to find that ISL can attenuate 5-FU-induced intestinal mucositis in mice. Its anti-mucositis effect may be through regulating TNF/NF-kappaB pathway and inhibiting inflammatory mediators PTGS2 and NOS2. It will provide a potential candidate for the prevention and treatment of chemotherapy-induced intestinal mucositis.
abstract_zh: 5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU）是治疗恶性肿瘤最广泛使用的化疗药物之一。然而，5-FU引起的肠道黏膜炎是一种严重的剂量限制性毒性反应，甚至导致治疗中断。异甘草素（ISL）是甘草的主要活性成分之一，甘草是一种常用于炎症和胃肠道疾病的传统中草药。推测ISL对肠道黏膜炎具有保护作用。然而，目前尚无此类研究报告。因此，为探讨ISL对5-FU诱导的肠道黏膜炎的影响，本研究提出了一种基于网络预测和药理学实验验证的策略。首先，通过网络分析预测ISL缓解5-FU诱导的胃肠道毒性的靶点和机制，并通过分子对接进一步确认结果。随后，通过腹腔注射5-FU（384 μmol/kg）建立肠道黏膜炎小鼠模型，以验证网络分析的预测。网络分析结果表明，PTGS2（前列腺素G/H合酶2）和NOS2（诱导型一氧化氮合酶）可能是ISL降低5-FU肠道毒性的关键靶点。此外，KEGG和GO富集分析显示，HIF-1、TNF、MAPK、IL-17、PI3K-Akt、Ras、NF-κB信号通路，以及炎症反应、凋亡调控、NO产生和NF-κB转录因子活性等生物学过程可能参与ISL对抗肠道黏膜炎的机制。后续动物实验表明，ISL可减轻5-FU引起的体重下降、白细胞减少和黏膜损伤。与肠道黏膜炎模型相比，ISL治疗后PTGS2、NOS2、TNFα（肿瘤坏死因子-α）和NF-κB p65（核因子κB P65）的蛋白表达降低。总之，本研究首次发现ISL可减轻5-FU诱导的小鼠肠道黏膜炎。其抗黏膜炎作用可能通过调节TNF/NF-κB通路并抑制炎症介质PTGS2和NOS2实现。这将为化疗诱导的肠道黏膜炎的预防和治疗提供潜在候选药物。
